notes: First PL run 2026-11-02. Every entry page opened with WebFetch; aggregator pages (worldpetnet, znanylekarz, gost24, doweta etc.) used only to discover URLs. 24 h marked only where the clinic page says 24 h / całą dobę / całodobowo / 24/7; several are conditional (emergency duty or phone line outside regular hours) and say so in note: AMVET Kraków and Gdańsk, Luxvet24, UR Kraków, Giszowiec, Ołtaszyńska, OIOMVET (24 h only Fri-Sun), ARKA. Not marked 24 h despite wording: KORA Bydgoszcz (page says całą dobę but hours end in evening), Gdynia Stryjska (duty to 24:00 only; aggregators call it 24h), Bydgoszcz/Toruń Pogotowie (night 20-8, 24 h Sun/holidays, schedule not tied to a site), Witolińska Warszawa (7-23). Duty rotas: Poland has no national or chamber-run rota that could be opened; Krajowa Izba Lekarsko-Weterynaryjna page returned unreadable content and regional chambers were not reachable; only the City of Łódź list is included as duty_rota. Poison line: none included - no opened page names a real animal poison information line in Poland (human poison centres were not claimed to advise on animals). Koszalin: an advocacy page (vet-alert.org) reports that in Jan 2025 the Zachodniopomorska izba said no Koszalin clinic is registered as 24 h; no Koszalin/Kołobrzeg/Słupsk (Baltic coast) 24 h clinic included. Not done / left for follow-up: UP Wrocław SOR (announced for early 2026, kliniki.upwr.edu.pl pages returned errors), UP Poznań UCMW (robots disallowed), ZUT Szczecin (no clinic found), Warszawa Ursynów lecznica-ursynow.waw.pl and Morskie Oko (site redirect loop / not opened), VETS Warsaw, Bemowo, Vet Med Brwinów, Gdyński Szpital Weterynaryjny Kielecka 22 (only group news page, hospital 24/7 supervised), AMVET-group others; Gdynia/Sopot own-site 24 h clinics; Zakopane and Mazury 24 h clinics (none found); Białystok, Opole, Kielce, Zielona Góra, Olsztyn 24 h private clinics; regional chambers (okręgowe izby) duty pages; Piła Matuszewscy (24 h phone line only, not a clinic claim). Independent check 2026-11-02: opened source_url of all 31 24-h entries, the Łódź duty rota and 2 random other clinics (VetMaria, Bydgoszcz/Toruń Pogotowie) - 34 checked, 0 phones fixed, 0 downgraded, 0 removed. 24-h wording confirmed on every page (several conditional, see notes: OIOMVET Mon-Thu 8-24, AMVET/Luxvet24/Sosken/UR Kraków/Giszowiec/Ołtaszyńska emergency duty outside regular hours, Centrum Bydgoszcz night = emergencies only). Remaining ~7 other clinics not re-opened.
